say:0:1013601001:0.text: This camp makes me a little worried...
say:0:1013601001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，这新出现的奇怪营地，令我有一些担忧。
say:0:1013601001:0.male: This camp makes me a little worried...
say:0:1013601001:0.female: This camp makes me a little worried...

say:1:1013601002:0.text: Yes, we should definitely investigate further.
say:1:1013601002:0.source_cn: 确实很奇怪，如果之后再次遇到，最好调查一下。
say:1:1013601002:0.male: Yes, we should definitely investigate further.
say:1:1013601002:0.female: Yes, we should definitely investigate further.

say:2:1013601003:0.text: Additionally, I'm a little worried about that Mauler...
say:2:1013601003:0.source_cn: 另外，我也有点在意那个蛮血……
say:2:1013601003:0.male: Additionally, I'm a little worried about that Mauler...
say:2:1013601003:0.female: Additionally, I'm a little worried about that Mauler...

say:0:1013602001:0.text: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—
say:0:1013602001:0.source_cn: 呜哇！主人，看到了吗？这里有铁锹、铲子、石板和魔偶材料——
say:0:1013602001:0.male: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—
say:0:1013602001:0.female: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—

say:1:1013602002:0.text: It's like we're back at the Evergreen Conservatory's camp!
say:1:1013602002:0.source_cn: 简直有点像冬青学会的地盘！

say:2:1013602003:0.text: But the people here don't seem like scholars at all...
say:2:1013602003:0.source_cn: 但这里活动的家伙们，一点都不像学者……

say:1:1013604001:2.text: You've done well, staying alive long enough to meet me again.
say:1:1013604001:2.source_cn: 做得很好，你们活着见到了我。

say:3:1013604002:1.text: That's a strange way to put it...

choice_prompt:4:1013604002.text: That's a strange way to put it...

say:5:1013604003:1.text: Don't forget my warning; this place is far from simple.
say:5:1013604003:1.source_cn: 你们刚才的嘀嘀咕咕，我都听到了。别忘了我的警告，这块地...

say:6:1013604005:1.text: If you want to know more—let your strength do the talking!
say:6:1013604005:1.source_cn: 要想知道更多情报——就用实力说话吧！
say:6:1013604005:1.male: If you want to know more—let your strength do the talking!
say:6:1013604005:1.female: If you want to know more—let your strength do the talking!

say:8:1013604006:1.text: He obviously wants to tell us, but he just has to have one more battle...
say:8:1013604006:1.source_cn: 明明一副很想告诉我们的样子……

say:10:1013604004:1.text: This camp? Hmph, I can't just tell you without anything in return.
say:10:1013604004:1.source_cn: 你说这片营地吗？哼，我可不能随意地告诉你
say:10:1013604004:1.male: This camp? Hmph, I can't just tell you without anything in return.
say:10:1013604004:1.female: This camp? Hmph, I can't just tell you without anything in return.

say:1:1013608001:1.text: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.
say:1:1013608001:1.source_cn: 就如我们战前约定的那样，你们想知道什么，就问吧。
say:1:1013608001:1.male: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.
say:1:1013608001:1.female: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.

say:2:1013608002:1.text: But first, tell me your name.
say:2:1013608002:1.source_cn: 不过在此之前，请告诉我你的名字。
say:2:1013608002:1.male: But first, tell me your name.
say:2:1013608002:1.female: But first, tell me your name.

choice_prompt:3:1013608002.text: But first, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.source_cn: 不过在此之前，请告诉我你的名字。
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.male: But first, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.female: But first, tell me your name.

say:6:1013608005:2.text: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!
say:6:1013608005:2.source_cn: 那么，沙奎尔先生，就请认真回答主人的问题！
say:6:1013608005:2.male: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!
say:6:1013608005:2.female: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!

say:7:1013608006:0.source_cn: 我不会违背许下的诺言。

choice_prompt:9:1013608006.source_cn: 我不会违背许下的诺言。

say:10:1013608007:1.text: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!
say:10:1013608007:1.source_cn: 黑金商会雇佣了我，但这里可不是他们的地盘。这里属于我！...
say:10:1013608007:1.male: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!
say:10:1013608007:1.female: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!

say:11:1013608010:0.text: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.
say:11:1013608010:0.source_cn: 你见过我手下那群弱小的人吗？他们也是被黑金雇佣的人，但...
say:11:1013608010:0.male: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.
say:11:1013608010:0.female: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.

say:12:1013608011:0.text: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
say:12:1013608011:0.source_cn: 所以他们只能去干一些黑金商会安排的活，影响武技的磨练。
say:12:1013608011:0.male: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
say:12:1013608011:0.female: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.

choice_prompt:13:1013608011.text: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.source_cn: 所以他们只能去干一些黑金商会安排的活，影响武技的磨练。
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.male: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.female: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.

say:14:1013608012:1.text: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.
say:14:1013608012:1.source_cn: 我从荒角沙漠而来，只为磨炼武技，增强力量。在你之前，魔...
say:14:1013608012:1.male: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.
say:14:1013608012:1.female: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.

say:15:1013608013:1.text: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.
say:15:1013608013:1.source_cn: 虽然总会损坏，但每次都有新的替补。
say:15:1013608013:1.male: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.
say:15:1013608013:1.female: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.

say:17:1013608015:0.text: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.
say:17:1013608015:0.source_cn: 听起来，这一切还是黑金商会阴谋的一环，但他们的目的我们...
say:17:1013608015:0.male: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.
say:17:1013608015:0.female: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.

say:18:1013608016:2.text: Shakir, can we speak to your crew?
say:18:1013608016:2.source_cn: 沙奎尔先生，我们能否向你的手下询问？

say:19:1013608017:0.text: Sure, but I should warn you if you want to fight them, they're pretty weak.
say:19:1013608017:0.source_cn: 可以，但他们太弱小了，不经打。

say:21:1013608018:2.text: ... I promise you, we only want to ask them questions.

say:22:1013608019:2.text: Alright. Hey, you lot! Over here!
say:22:1013608019:2.source_cn: 这样吗？喂，你们几个！就是你们几个，过来！

say:24:1013608020:3.source_cn: 啊……老大，你是在叫我们吗？

say:25:1013608021:0.text: Yeah, these folks are opponents I respect. You'd better answer their questions truthfully!
say:25:1013608021:0.source_cn: 没错，这些人是我尊重的对手，他们有话要问你们，老实回答！

say:26:1013608022:0.text: And as for me, let me clean up a bit. My claws and fur got dirty during the battle...
say:26:1013608022:0.source_cn: 至于我，容我先清理一下，战斗中弄脏的爪子和皮毛……

say:28:1013608014:1.text: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.
say:28:1013608014:1.source_cn: 很无聊的活计，挖掘、盗宝、组装还有运输。
say:28:1013608014:1.male: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.
say:28:1013608014:1.female: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.

choice:13:1:2.text: What tasks do they give you?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 黑金商会安排什么样的活？
choice:13:1:2.male: What tasks do they give you?
choice:13:1:2.female: What tasks do they give you?

say:29:1013608008:0.text: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
say:29:1013608008:0.source_cn: 这里是我的营地！我用这双利爪打下来的！
say:29:1013608008:0.male: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
say:29:1013608008:0.female: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!

choice_prompt:30:1013608008.text: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.source_cn: 这里是我的营地！我用这双利爪打下来的！
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.male: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.female: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!

say:31:1013608009:0.text: They hired me to manage these folks.
say:31:1013608009:0.source_cn: 黑金商会雇了我，让我安排人干一些事情。
say:31:1013608009:0.male: They hired me to manage these folks.
say:31:1013608009:0.female: They hired me to manage these folks.

choice:30:0:1.text: How do you know the Syndicate?
choice:30:0:1.male: How do you know the Syndicate?
choice:30:0:1.female: How do you know the Syndicate?

say:32:1013608004:0.text: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!
say:32:1013608004:0.source_cn: 总觉得在哪里听过，这一定是命运对我们相遇的暗示！
say:32:1013608004:0.male: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!
say:32:1013608004:0.female: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!

say:0:1013609001:0.text: Hmph, you think we'd be willing to trust anyone outside of the camp?
say:0:1013609001:0.source_cn: 哼，就你们也想套我们的话！

say:1:1013609002:0.text: Stop talking and start fighting them already!
say:1:1013609002:0.source_cn: 别跟他们废话，先揍了再说。

say:1:1013611001:3.text: What kind of tasks does the Adamant Syndicate usually give you?
say:1:1013611001:3.source_cn: 黑金商会日常都让你们做些什么？

say:2:1013611002:0.text: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?
say:2:1013611002:0.source_cn: 原来各位是想知道这个。莫非也打算分一杯羹？呃，可是我们...
say:2:1013611002:0.male: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?
say:2:1013611002:0.female: Curious, huh? You want a piece of the pie, don't you?

say:3:1013611003:1.text: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.
say:3:1013611003:1.source_cn: 除了帮黑金运送宝物去他们的营地，派几个人去组装一些东西...
say:3:1013611003:1.male: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.
say:3:1013611003:1.female: Alright, I'll tell you. We've mostly just been transporting treasures to their camps and putting things together.

say:4:1013611004:1.text: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.
say:4:1013611004:1.source_cn: 毕竟这附近的遗迹我们都摸透了！哦，日神殿除外。
say:4:1013611004:1.male: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.
say:4:1013611004:1.female: We've pretty much explored all the nearby ruins! Oh, except for the Sun Temple.

say:5:1013611005:1.source_cn: 日神殿……有什么特殊之处吗？

say:6:1013611006:1.text: The Syndicate locked down that whole area. Probably hoarding all that treasure to themselves!
say:6:1013611006:1.source_cn: 还不是黑金的人独霸着那块地方，不让我们过去。多半是想独...

say:9:1013611008:1.text: We're not entirely sure about the details, but it seems like that! Otherwise, why would they guard it so fiercely?
say:9:1013611008:1.source_cn: 具体的我们也不清楚，只是看着像这么回事！不然，日神殿里...

say:3:1013612002:1.text: One day, that big brute stormed into our camp, throwing punches everywhere.
say:3:1013612002:1.source_cn: 嚯，那个大老粗……有一天突然就挥着拳头闯进营地里。把我...

say:4:1013612003:1.text: The Syndicate folks saw him and insisted he become the leader! We wanted nothing to do with him, but none of us could defeat him so...
say:4:1013612003:1.source_cn: 正好被黑金的人看见了，非要让他当老大！要不是打不过，我...

choice_prompt:5:1013612003.text: The Syndicate folks saw him and insisted he become the leader! We wanted nothing to do with him, but none of us could defeat him so...
choice_prompt:5:1013612003.source_cn: 正好被黑金的人看见了，非要让他当老大！要不是打不过，我们真、真不想理他……

say:6:1013612004:1.text: Yeah, I mean the training was so hard! He made us run between two camps ten times a day! Who can handle that?
say:6:1013612004:1.source_cn: 训练太累了！他让我们每天从两个营地之间来回跑十次！这谁...

say:7:1013612005:1.text: I hate him! Some people tried to sneak away, but once they got caught, the training became even more horrifying!
say:7:1013612005:1.source_cn: 真是恨死他了！有些人偷偷跑了，但被抓回来之后就是更可怕...

say:9:1013612006:1.text: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...
say:9:1013612006:1.source_cn: 还不是因为他能打呗！但要我说，他脑子有点不好使……
say:9:1013612006:1.male: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...
say:9:1013612006:1.female: Because he's super strong! But in my opinion, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed...

say:10:1013612007:1.text: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
say:10:1013612007:1.source_cn: 下面有人欺上瞒下，他也一直没发现……
say:10:1013612007:1.male: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
say:10:1013612007:1.female: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...

choice_prompt:11:1013612007.text: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
choice_prompt:11:1013612007.source_cn: 下面有人欺上瞒下，他也一直没发现……
choice_prompt:11:1013612007.male: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...
choice_prompt:11:1013612007.female: He doesn't even notice when someone's deceiving him...

say:12:1013612008:1.text: Oh no! I didn't say anything, stop asking! Anyway, it has nothing to do with the big brute or the Syndicate!
say:12:1013612008:1.source_cn: 糟糕！我什么都没说，你别问了！反正与大老粗和黑金都没有关系！
say:12:1013612008:1.male: Oh no! I didn't say anything, stop asking! Anyway, it has nothing to do with the big brute or the Syndicate!
say:12:1013612008:1.female: Oh no! I didn't say anything, stop asking! Anyway, it has nothing to do with the big brute or the Syndicate!

choice:5:1:2.text: Why'd they make him the leader?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 为什么黑金的人让他当老大？
choice:5:1:2.male: Why'd they make him the leader?
choice:5:1:2.female: Why'd they make him the leader?

say:0:1013613001:0.text: ...Seems like this gang of treasure thieves doesn't know that much.
say:0:1013613001:0.source_cn: ……看来，这群盗宝贼只知道这么多了。
say:0:1013613001:0.male: ...Seems like this gang of treasure thieves doesn't know that much.
say:0:1013613001:0.female: ...Seems like this gang of treasure thieves doesn't know that much.

say:1:1013613002:0.text: The Syndicate has its sights set on the Sun Temple, that much is clear.
say:1:1013613002:0.source_cn: 黑金商会的目标是日神殿，这件事似乎没有疑问。
say:1:1013613002:0.male: The Syndicate has its sights set on the Sun Temple, that much is clear.
say:1:1013613002:0.female: The Syndicate has its sights set on the Sun Temple, that much is clear.

say:2:1013613003:0.text: Then we better hurry to the Sun Temple!
say:2:1013613003:0.source_cn: 那我们可得快点赶到日神殿！
say:2:1013613003:0.male: Then we better hurry to the Sun Temple!
say:2:1013613003:0.female: Then we better hurry to the Sun Temple!

say:0:1013614001:0.text: We're not far from the Ruins Plaza. Should we take a break or continue?
say:0:1013614001:0.source_cn: 从桥的风格判断，这里距遗迹广场应该不远了。是要一鼓作气...
say:0:1013614001:0.male: We're not far from the Ruins Plaza. Should we take a break or continue?
say:0:1013614001:0.female: We're not far from the Ruins Plaza. Should we take a break or continue?

say:1:1013614002:0.text: Let's push ahead to the Ruins Plaza and take a breather there.
say:1:1013614002:0.source_cn: 继续前行吧，在遗迹广场休整。
say:1:1013614002:0.male: Let's push ahead to the Ruins Plaza and take a breather there.
say:1:1013614002:0.female: Let's push ahead to the Ruins Plaza and take a breather there.

say:2:1013615001:1.text: I think this is a good spot to rest!
say:2:1013615001:1.source_cn: 就在这片遗迹广场休息一下吧，梅林大人？
say:2:1013615001:1.male: I think this is a good spot to rest!
say:2:1013615001:1.female: I think this is a good spot to rest!

choice_prompt:3:1013615001.text: I think this is a good spot to rest!
choice_prompt:3:1013615001.source_cn: 就在这片遗迹广场休息一下吧，梅林大人？
choice_prompt:3:1013615001.male: I think this is a good spot to rest!
choice_prompt:3:1013615001.female: I think this is a good spot to rest!

say:4:1013615002:1.text: Ah, resting after a long journey feels amazing...
say:4:1013615002:1.source_cn: 呼！长途奔波后的休憩，真是舒服啊……

say:5:1013615003:1.text: Besides the travel, I've been thinking about a series of events that have occurred, and some things are puzzling.
say:5:1013615003:1.source_cn: 沿途除了赶路，我还想着发生的一系列事情，多少有点想不通。

say:6:1013615005:1.text: It seems reactivating the golems was just their temporary goal. But I can't figure out the link between the golems and their plan concerning the Sun Temple.
say:6:1013615005:1.source_cn: 嗯，重启魔偶似乎只是他们中途的目的。但我不明白魔偶与他...

say:7:1013615006:1.text: Before we left, we received a plea for help from the Sun Temple. But since the portal was destroyed, we had to rush from Holistone.
say:7:1013615006:1.source_cn: 在我们出发之前，圣堂收到日神殿的传信要求增援。但传送门...

say:8:1013615007:1.text: And about the sacred items in the Sun Temple? It's strange. Considering Soleih has long fallen, why would there still be sacred items there?
say:8:1013615007:1.source_cn: 而且，在日神殿的圣物？也颇有奇怪之处。毕竟日神早已陨落...

say:9:1013615008:1.text: Regardless, the Adamant Syndicate's objective appears to revolve around these sacred items. And it seems they've been planning for quite some time...
say:9:1013615008:1.source_cn: 但无论如何，黑金商会的目的疑似指向了圣物。而且，他们布...

say:10:1013615009:2.text: Dura above! I'm as nervous as it is! Let's all calm down... The more anxious we are, the more we must focus and conserve our strength!
say:10:1013615009:2.source_cn: 艾雅在上，特弥希娅，我和你一样着急……可越是着急，越要...

say:11:1013615010:2.text: Right. I can't afford to panic at this point.
say:11:1013615010:2.source_cn: 你说得对，卢修斯，多谢。事情已经到了现在这个地步，更不...

say:12:1013615011:2.text: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.
say:12:1013615011:2.source_cn: 梅林大人，卢修斯，你们快去休息吧。别的事明天再聊。
say:12:1013615011:2.male: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.
say:12:1013615011:2.female: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.

say:15:1013615004:1.text: It'd be best to organize the information we've gathered while we have the time.
say:15:1013615004:1.source_cn: 啊。趁现在有空，还是整理一下已获得的情报比较好。

choice:3:1:2.text: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.
choice:3:1:2.male: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.
choice:3:1:2.female: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616001:.text:
Dura above, as the stars fade and the sunrise arrives,
please bless our journey to be smooth.
Please protect my comrades fighting by my side.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616001:.source_cn:
艾雅在上，当星月落尽朝阳升起，
请保佑我们踏上坦途。
请保佑与我并肩作战的同伴。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616002:.text:
For the sin of not recovering the Faith Stone after all these years,
I swear to make amends, no matter the cost—
cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616002:.source_cn:
时隔多年，那未能寻回圣石之罪，
我将立誓偿还，不惜代价——

say:5:1013617001:2.text: What price are you willing to pay?

say:6:1013617002:2.text: ...Am I dreaming? Atalanta, why are you here?
say:6:1013617002:2.source_cn: 我在做梦吗？阿塔兰忒，你为什么在这里？

say:7:1013617003:0.text: This isn't a dream. I'm here... in the flesh.
say:7:1013617003:0.source_cn: 你才不会梦到我呢。我就在这里……实实在在的。

say:8:1013617004:0.text: How many times must I say it? The past was my sin, not yours. But even if I were given another chance, I would make the same choice.
say:8:1013617004:0.source_cn: 还要我说多少次？当年的事，是我的罪，不是你的。但即使再...

say:9:1013617005:0.text: Are you still refusing to tell me the truth from back then?
say:9:1013617005:0.source_cn: 你还是不打算告诉我当年的真相吗？

say:10:1013617006:0.text: You know I don't want to talk about it. Why do you keep asking?
say:10:1013617006:0.source_cn: 明知道我不想说，你为何要问？我应该说过你，别这么不解风情。

say:11:1013617007:0.source_cn: 这不是开玩笑的时候，阿塔兰忒。

say:12:1013617008:0.text: Ever since I became a knight, I pledged to protect Dura. Until this day, I've followed the strictest laws of the Temple...
say:12:1013617008:0.source_cn: 我从成为骑士的那天起，就立誓守护艾雅。时至今日，我践行...

say:13:1013617009:0.text: Yet I'm still a sinner. Because, truthfully, I'm just as despicable as the worst scoundrel in this world... I willingly betrayed the grace of the goddess.
say:13:1013617009:0.source_cn: 但我仍是罪人。因为我的的确确，与世间最卑劣的恶徒一样…...

say:14:1013617010:0.text: I let you go that time. But you know, I don't regret it either.
say:14:1013617010:0.source_cn: 我放你离开了。但你知道的，我也不后悔。

say:15:1013617011:0.text: Given another chance, I'd make the same choice.
say:15:1013617011:0.source_cn: 我想说与你一样的话，即使再给我一次机会，我也会作出相同...

say:16:1013617012:0.text: But... I must make amends. To ensure my redemption isn't in vain, Atalanta, just tell me the truth...
say:16:1013617012:0.source_cn: 但……我必须为此赎罪。为了让我的赎罪不至于毫无价值，阿...

cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616001:.text:
Dura above, as the stars fade and the sunrise arrives,
please bless our journey to be smooth.
Please protect my comrades fighting by my side.
cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616001:.source_cn:
艾雅在上，当星月落尽朝阳升起，
请保佑我们踏上坦途。
请保佑与我并肩作战的同伴。

cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616002:.text:
For the sin of not recovering the Faith Stone after all these years,
I swear to make amends, no matter the cost—
cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616002:.source_cn:
时隔多年，那未能寻回圣石之罪，
我将立誓偿还，不惜代价——

narration:22:10136222:0.text: As the conversation between Temesia and Atalanta reaches a stalemate, Dionel suddenly makes an appearance.
narration:22:10136222:0.source_cn: 眼看特弥希娅和阿塔兰忒之间的对话快要陷入僵局，萨基塔里...

narration:23:10136221:0.text: Temesia devoutly prays to Dura, pledging to recover the Faith Stone. At that moment, the supposedly missing Atalanta reappears.
narration:23:10136221:0.source_cn: 守夜的特弥希娅向艾雅虔诚祈祷，发誓定要寻回圣石。就在此...

say:1:1013618001:3.text: Archon Dionel! What are you doing here?
say:1:1013618001:3.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯大人！您为什么在这里！

say:2:1013618002:1.text: I arrived at an interesting moment. Or should I say, an unfortunate one?
say:2:1013618002:1.source_cn: 我来得巧了。或者说，不太巧？

say:3:1013618003:1.text: I should've brought my harp. Doesn't this situation feel like it needs a musical accompaniment?
say:3:1013618003:1.source_cn: 呵，真该带上我的竖琴的。此时此刻的情节，不觉得正适合伴...

say:9:1013618006:2.text: Huh, is that Atalanta? Weren't you sent back to Holistone? Why are you here?
say:9:1013618006:2.source_cn: 发出声音的是——咦，阿塔兰忒？你、你不是被送回圣石镇了...

say:10:1013618007:1.text: Well, she had to be here. She's the leading lady in this comedy show.
say:10:1013618007:1.source_cn: 当然要在场了。她可是这场人间喜剧重要的女主角。

say:11:1013618008:1.text: Huh? Comedy? What comedy... Hold on, is that—Archon Dionel?!
say:11:1013618008:1.source_cn: 啊？喜剧？什么喜剧……说话的居然是萨基塔里斯阁下！

say:12:1013618009:0.text: Of course, I'm also an important spectator in this comedy.
say:12:1013618009:0.source_cn: 自然因为我也是这场喜剧重要的观众。

choice_prompt:14:1013618009.text: Of course, I'm also an important spectator in this comedy.
choice_prompt:14:1013618009.source_cn: 自然因为我也是这场喜剧重要的观众。

say:15:1013618010:0.text: Comedies don't always mean pure laughter. But by Dura, surely it won't turn into a tragedy.
say:15:1013618010:0.source_cn: 喜剧并不一定全然是欢笑。但艾雅在上，总不会放任此事变成悲剧。
say:15:1013618010:0.male: Comedies don't always mean pure laughter. But by Dura, surely it won't turn into a tragedy.
say:15:1013618010:0.female: Comedies don't always mean pure laughter. But by Dura, surely it won't turn into a tragedy.

say:16:1013618012:1.text: However, this fantastic act has concluded. Call me for the next scene.
say:16:1013618012:1.source_cn: 不过，精彩的一幕结束了。下一幕再呼唤我吧。

choice:14:0:1.text: I think you've got the genre wrong...
choice:14:0:1.male: I think you've got the genre wrong...
choice:14:0:1.female: I think you've got the genre wrong...

say:18:1013618011:1.text: The arguments you humans get up to are quite intriguing, and the ending wasn't that bad.
say:18:1013618011:1.source_cn: 夸张、诙谐、转折，但结局总归不差。
say:18:1013618011:1.male: The arguments you humans get up to are quite intriguing, and the ending wasn't that bad.
say:18:1013618011:1.female: The arguments you humans get up to are quite intriguing, and the ending wasn't that bad.

say:1:1013619001:2.text: Your acquaintance vanished suddenly. Is everything okay?
say:1:1013619001:2.source_cn: 你们的熟人突然消失了。没关系吗？

say:2:1013619002:1.text: Atalanta, the more important question is how you're even here.
say:2:1013619002:1.source_cn: 这位大人风格如此，倒是阿塔兰忒……

choice_prompt:3:1013619002.text: Atalanta, the more important question is how you're even here.
choice_prompt:3:1013619002.source_cn: 这位大人风格如此，倒是阿塔兰忒……

say:4:1013619003:1.text: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.
say:4:1013619003:1.source_cn: 啊，返回圣石镇后，维伦就去汇报了。
say:4:1013619003:1.male: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.
say:4:1013619003:1.female: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.

say:5:1013619004:1.text: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
say:5:1013619004:1.source_cn: 他也是太小看我了，区区几个圣石镇民兵，怎么可能看得住我？
say:5:1013619004:1.male: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
say:5:1013619004:1.female: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.

choice_prompt:6:1013619004.text: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
choice_prompt:6:1013619004.source_cn: 他也是太小看我了，区区几个圣石镇民兵，怎么可能看得住我？
choice_prompt:6:1013619004.male: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
choice_prompt:6:1013619004.female: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.

say:7:1013619005:1.text: Come on, it was you guys who insisted on making things tough for me in the first place.
say:7:1013619005:1.source_cn: 话不能这么说，明明是你们几个硬要跟我为难的嘛。

say:8:1013619006:1.text: Additionally, my role as your guide isn't over yet. I still have to escort you to the Sun Temple.
say:8:1013619006:1.source_cn: 而且，我这个向导的工作明明还没结束。我得带着你们去日神...

say:10:1013619007:2.text: You're willing to lead us to the Sun Temple all of a sudden? Last time, you even used force to stop Temesia!
say:10:1013619007:2.source_cn: 忽然就肯带我们去日神殿？上次，你为了阻挠特弥希娅，甚至...

say:11:1013619008:1.text: Because Temesia packs quite a punch, and I didn't want to get hit again, alright?
say:11:1013619008:1.source_cn: 就当是特弥希娅打人太痛，我不想再挨打了，行了吧？

say:12:1013619009:1.text: Even though I'm a suspect in the theft of the Faith Stone, I've been with you guys all this time, and I haven't done anything to hurt you.
say:12:1013619009:1.source_cn: 即使我是圣石失窃的嫌疑人，但我就在你们眼皮底下行动，你...

say:13:1013619010:1.text: I already saved Temesia once—who's to say it can't happen again?
say:13:1013619010:1.source_cn: 我既然救过你一次——我就不信，救不了第二次。

say:15:1013619011:1.text: So, let me tag along with you. And what about you, my stubborn knight, what do you think?
say:15:1013619011:1.source_cn: 所以，就让我跟着你们吧。某位不听劝的圣骑士，你怎么说？

say:16:1013619012:2.text: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
say:16:1013619012:2.male: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
say:16:1013619012:2.female: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.

choice_prompt:17:1013619012.text: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
choice_prompt:17:1013619012.source_cn: ……我无话可说，一切交由<style=stress><player_name></style>大人决定。
choice_prompt:17:1013619012.male: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
choice_prompt:17:1013619012.female: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.

say:20:1013619014:2.text: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.
say:20:1013619014:2.source_cn: 我刚成为骑士时，还很弱小。一次被派去与魔物战斗后，身受...
say:20:1013619014:2.male: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.
say:20:1013619014:2.female: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.

say:21:1013619015:1.text: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.
say:21:1013619015:1.source_cn: 醒来时，就看到阿塔兰忒在我床前。我才知道，是她历尽辛苦...
say:21:1013619015:1.male: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.
say:21:1013619015:1.female: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.

say:22:1013619016:1.text: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.
say:22:1013619016:1.source_cn: ……命运弄人。我痊愈后的第一个任务，就是追捕盗窃圣石的疑犯。
say:22:1013619016:1.male: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.
say:22:1013619016:1.female: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.

say:23:1013619017:1.text: Why bring up these old tales out of the blue?
say:23:1013619017:1.source_cn: 为什么突然开始说这些陈年旧事？

say:24:1013619018:2.text: Just pondering—for someone like me, unable to let go of personal feelings... becoming a sinner is inevitable.
say:24:1013619018:2.source_cn: 没什么。只是在想，我这样无法舍弃私情的人……会成为罪人...

say:25:1013619019:1.text: I shouldn't have let personal feelings interfere, going against the goddess' will...
say:25:1013619019:1.source_cn: 我本不该顾念私情，违背女神的旨意……

say:26:1013619020:1.text: Is the goddess the only reason worth living for to you?
say:26:1013619020:1.source_cn: 只有女神，才值得你活着吗？

say:28:1013619021:1.text: I'm a bit confused about your history and relationship...
say:28:1013619021:1.source_cn: 我有点搞不清楚你们俩的过去和关系了……

say:29:1013619022:1.text: Please allow us to have another private conversation...
say:29:1013619022:1.source_cn: 诸位，请允许我们再私下交谈一番……

say:0:1013620001:0.text: I'm curious about that magical potion...
say:0:1013620001:0.source_cn: 我有点在意那个魔法药剂……
say:0:1013620001:0.male: I'm curious about that magical potion...
say:0:1013620001:0.female: I'm curious about that magical potion...

say:1:1013620002:0.text: That magical potion is indeed fascinating!
say:1:1013620002:0.source_cn: 不愧是梅林！那个“魔法药剂”的确令人在意！它有些过分神奇了。
say:1:1013620002:0.male: That magical potion is indeed fascinating!
say:1:1013620002:0.female: That magical potion is indeed fascinating!

say:2:1013620003:0.text: Especially because only a grand magister like Merlin could make something like that...
say:2:1013620003:0.source_cn: 且不说只有像梅林这样的大魔法师才能配置那样的药剂……
say:2:1013620003:0.male: Especially because only a grand magister like Merlin could make something like that...
say:2:1013620003:0.female: Especially because only a grand magister like Merlin could make something like that...

say:3:1013620004:0.text: When you consider how much the medicinal herbs alone must've cost...
say:3:1013620004:0.source_cn: 单纯从药材而言都不可思议！可是，阿塔兰忒也确确实实救了...
say:3:1013620004:0.male: When you consider how much the medicinal herbs alone must've cost...
say:3:1013620004:0.female: When you consider how much the medicinal herbs alone must've cost...

say:4:1013620005:0.text: Did Atalanta spend so much effort into saving Temesia and stealing the Faith Stone at the same time?
say:4:1013620005:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒想救特弥希娅的命……却又几乎在同时偷窃圣石吗？
say:4:1013620005:0.male: Did Atalanta spend so much effort into saving Temesia and stealing the Faith Stone at the same time?
say:4:1013620005:0.female: Did Atalanta spend so much effort into saving Temesia and stealing the Faith Stone at the same time?

say:1:1013621002:0.text: Hmm, all the answers lie within the Sun Temple...
say:1:1013621002:0.source_cn: 嗯，一切的答案都在日神殿了……
say:1:1013621002:0.male: Hmm, all the answers lie within the Sun Temple...
say:1:1013621002:0.female: Hmm, all the answers lie within the Sun Temple...

say:0:1013622001:0.text: We're completely stuck! When will we ever reach the Sun Temple?
say:0:1013622001:0.source_cn: 不，不行，这里也走不通。现在根本无法前进！到底什么时候...

say:2:1013622003:0.text: You're giving me too much credit! I've never been here either...
say:2:1013622003:0.source_cn: 你未免也把我想得太神通广大了！我也没有来过这里……在附...

say:0:1013623001:0.text: As someone who hunts for treasures, I say we should try going down from here!
say:0:1013623001:0.source_cn: 寻宝猎人的经验告诉我——只能从这里下去试试了！

say:1:1013623002:0.text: There's no other choice; let's go down and take a look.
say:1:1013623002:0.source_cn: 别无他法了，先下去看看。
say:1:1013623002:0.male: There's no other choice; let's go down and take a look.
say:1:1013623002:0.female: There's no other choice; let's go down and take a look.

say:0:1013624001:0.text: Huh, this area is surprisingly spacious.
say:0:1013624001:0.source_cn: 底部的空间意外地宽敞。

say:1:1013624002:0.text: Ha! It looks like we're heading in the right direction. Wait, these are...
say:1:1013624002:0.source_cn: 哈，看来走对路了。等等，地下这些东西是……

say:2:1013624003:0.source_cn: 这些零件，看起来像是……魔偶身上的。

say:3:1013624004:0.source_cn: 以防万一，先调查看看吧。

say:4:1013625002:1.text: Exactly! The Adamant Syndicate utilizes this space to transport the assembled golems...
say:4:1013625002:1.source_cn: 没错！黑金商会利用这里，把组装好的大量魔偶运输出去……

say:5:1013625003:1.text: By Dura! But why would they do this?
say:5:1013625003:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！可是他们这么做，究竟想干什么？

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 这里是运输魔偶的通道

cinematic_dialogue:1:1013603002:.text: How dare you intrude on our camp!
